name: Wasteland Racers 2071
summary:
Wasteland Racers 2071 is a car racing game from Trio Tech Amusement. It uses a HD projection system onto a 52-inch widescreen monitor, as well as a surround sound system.

Players race through post-apocalyptic race tracks in recreated cities with a choice of the available souped-up cars including 'destroyer', 'interceptor', 'hellbender', 'dune raider', 'milkshake' and 'crusher'.

Wasteland is linkable for up to 8 machines for multiple player action. Upon completion of a perfect race, players will receive secret codes to unlock hidden tracks and cars. They will also receive a code to enter their high score online to view their worldwide ranking.
